links.comparator_used: Base setting, where the agent's first package is submitted without revision (Self-Refine, revision without external validator feedback, was a further arm)
links.outcome: P21 validator finding count (dataset-rule pairs) and failed derivation count
links.effect: Four of six CRITIC workflows had usable validator comparisons, and each reduced its finding count. None reduced its failed derivation count. Validator findings across settings ranged from 15 to 64 dataset-rule pairs.
links.tradeoff: Lower validator finding counts did not indicate more correct derivations. The package with the fewest findings carried none of the 234 efficacy summary records in the form the specifications define.
links.quote: Four of six CRITIC workflows had usable validator comparisons, and each reduced its finding count.
